description_en: `ListOutboundNumbersOfUser` retrieves the outbound numbers for a specified agent in a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListOutboundNumbersOfUser获取指定实例下指定坐席的可外呼号码
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-outbound-numbers-of-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --skill-group-id-list skillgroup1@ccc-test_,_skillgroup2@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOutboundNumbersOfUser

parameters.description_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100.
parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: A JSON-formatted list of skill group IDs. If specified, the operation returns outbound numbers for the specified skill groups. If omitted, it returns outbound numbers for all skill groups associated with the agent. Note: The agent must be a member of the specified skill groups.
parameters.description_zh: 签入技能组ID列表，非必填，默认为空，表示查询UserId归属的所有技能组的外呼号码，如果有值，则查询该值指定的技能组下的外呼号码。注意，此处传入的技能组ID必须是UserId所在的技能组的ID。
parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted list of skill group IDs. If specified, the operation returns outbound numbers for the specified skill groups. If omitted, it returns outbound numbers for all skill groups associated with the agent. Note: The agent must be a member of the specified skill groups
